prompt: A photorealistic, high-resolution lifestyle photograph of the same young woman with brown hair styled in a high ponytail, wearing a light cream-colored sweater, dark leggings, thick white socks, and white sneakers, sitting on a high rocky mountain peak overlooking a vast, breathtaking alpine valley with snow-capped peaks in the background.
